request.tone: hushed, clever night-time treasure hunt with a wry heroine and a dead founder's crackling voice for company
request.note: Catalog book authored by hand; there is no request text. Band, length and style are copied from the book metadata; tone is the plan author's reading.

pitch.hero: Nadia, a girl who reads every museum label and gets locked in overnight
pitch.want: to follow the torn map in her audio-guide pouch to the founder's hidden collection
pitch.obstacle: a dark museum, a humming night guard, a coded note and a founder who never left one door when three would do
pitch.stake: if she gives up, the town keeps believing its founder was a thief and its treasures stay lost
pitch.ending_kind: discovery: the hidden room found and the founder's name cleared, by the road the reader chooses

nadia.name: Nadia
nadia.want: to follow the mark to the founder's hidden collection, and to get home without trouble
nadia.voice: curious, wry, talks back to objects and to the founder's recording ("The curious sort would be me")

ellery.name: Ambrose Ellery
ellery.role: the long-dead founder, heard on his recorded tour
ellery.want: for a patient finder to decide what becomes of the treasures he hid
ellery.voice: dry, crackling like a fire, epigrams ("I was never a man for one door")

pym.name: Mr. Pym
pym.want: after thirty-one years, to find what the mark opens
pym.voice: hums on his rounds, does crosswords, gentle and dry ("Not a burglar, seven letters")

truth.statement: Founder Ambrose Ellery did not sell the town's treasures. To keep them from the museum's creditors he hid them in a room under the rotunda, opened by setting the heart globe's rings, and let the town call him a thief. Every piece belongs to the town, and he left a trail of marks, a token, a key and a code for a patient finder. The night guard, Pym, has hunted for it for thirty-one years and put his half of the map in handset thirteen.

nadia_locked_in.text: Nadia is locked in the Ellery Museum overnight with no signal, and nobody will miss her before morning.

half_map.text: Half of a torn old map was in the handset pouch, with a brass mark (a circle crossed by two lines) and a square-lettered pencil note: "The founder's hidden collection, start at the mark."

map_back_warning.text: The back of the map holds half a sentence, "My east wing is not gone, for it has one door left, and that door opens only", and a pencilled warning that the rope gallery door shuts itself, so wedge it.

chalk_message.text: Nadia chalked "LOCKED IN, NOT A BURGLAR, NADIA FROM CLASS 6B, BACK SOON" on the tour board and kept the chalk.

guard_on_rounds.text: A night guard walks the museum on rounds.

ellery_tour.text: The founder, Ambrose Ellery, recorded the audio tour himself almost a hundred years ago.

globe_heart.text: Stop one: the brass globe in the rotunda is the museum's heart, which most people look at for four seconds.

someone_searched.text: Someone else has recently been searching the exhibits.

guard_31_years.text: The night guard has been hunting for something in the museum for thirty-one years.

pym_made_map.text: The night guard, Pym, wrote on the map and put it in handset thirteen himself.

has_token.text: Nadia carries the founder's brass token, stamped with the mark and the words "LEAVE ME WHERE YOU TAKE."

glass_ring_note.text: An old label says the ring is glass and the real one, with much else, went somewhere safer; try the corridor.

east_wing_behind_egypt.text: The lost wing ringed on her map begins behind the Egyptian room.

token_of_house.text: The amulet case says the token of the house was removed by the founder and is not far away.

founder_to_hide.text: On the visitor ledger's first page the founder gave his reason for coming as "To hide something."

row_q.text: The founder's mark points to Row Q at the far end of the archive stacks.

finder_records.text: The founder's tour records are boxed 1 to 36, and four more, 37 to 40, are labelled "For the finder."

east_wing_arch.text: In the roped gallery a bricked-up arch, stop 29, leads to the founder's still-standing east wing.

founders_key.text: Nadia has the founder's small brass key, with a coded note and a tag stamped 37; it fits his study, his glass cabinet and his back stair.

has_glasses.text: Nadia kept the founder's round reading glasses.

cipher_tool.text: Nadia has found a way to read the founder's code.

cipher_shift_three.text: The founder's code is a three-place shift: each letter stands three places along the alphabet from the one it means, so every D is really an A.

reading_lamp_bulb.text: The green lamp on the founder's reading table still lights, so someone has been changing the bulb.

globe_combo.text: The decoded note: follow the stars to the heart of the house by the Astronomy Hall, the Map Room or the Clock Corridor, then set the globe's rings to four, nine and two.

liar_star.text: One of the painted stars in the Astronomy Hall is "a liar."

mind_crates.text: The hand-drawn chart in the atlas says "You are nearly there, so mind the crates."

globe_awake.text: The globe's pin has dropped and its three numbered rings are free: the heart is awake.

quarter_to_four_rule.text: The founder's rule in the rounds book: at a quarter to four, if the heart is awake, clockwork sets the rings by itself.

floor_opens_by_clockwork.text: When the rings come home (by hand, by the tile picture, or by the quarter-to-four clockwork) a slab beside the globe slides back, and it stays open until someone pushes it shut by hand.

pym_note.text: Pym saw her board, searched every room twice, and left a note: he is at the front desk with the kettle on.

vault_room.text: Under the rotunda is the founder's hidden room, stop 38, full of the town's treasures, with a sealed letter marked "To the finder", the other half of the map and a jewelled owl.

treasures_belong_to_town.text: Every piece in the hidden room belongs to the town; the founder hid it from men who meant to sell it.

founder_letter.text: The founder's letter: he hid the treasures from the museum's creditors and let the town call him a thief.

letter_ps_lamp.text: The letter's tiny postscript: whoever has kept changing the reading-lamp bulb has earned a look at the room.

catalogue_book.text: The founder's book lists every piece and where in the town it belongs.

whole_map_east_wing.text: The whole map shows the lost east wing, bricked up but standing, reached through the back of the last shelf.

map_back_whole.text: Joined, the back reads that the wing's one door opens from within onto the garden, and her key fits it.

owl_shelf_counts.text: Lifting the owl starts a spring under the shelf; the velvet shows a coin-sized hollow stamped with the mark.

staff_door_morning.text: The museum stays locked all night; Nadia can leave only once the first keys of the morning open the staff door, which lets out by the garden gate.

slab_closed_by_hand.text: Nadia pushes the marble slab back over the stair, so the floor looks as if it had never moved.

east_wing_paintings.text: The lost east wing is a long gallery hung with paintings the town was told were sold and lost.

n_open.event: Nadia is locked in the museum overnight; her handset's pouch holds half a torn map: "The founder's hidden collection, start at the mark."

n_desk.event: The night lights march toward her; read the map under the last lamp, or chalk a message for the guard on his rounds.

n_desk_map.event: The back of the map: half a sentence about the east wing's last door, and a warning to wedge the rope gallery door.

n_desk_chalk.event: Nadia chalks LOCKED IN, NOT A BURGLAR on the tour board and pockets the chalk.

n_start.event: In the rotunda, stop one: founder Ellery's recorded voice calls the brass globe the museum's heart.

a_gems1.event: The Gallery of Gems: Ellery on diamonds; a crooked case and a faint beeping.

a_gems_case.event: The case was opened in a hurry; a tilted vitrine and a fallen card: someone else has been looking.

a_gems_vitrine.event: Under the vitrine, the brass token with the mark, "LEAVE ME WHERE YOU TAKE"; an arrow to a hidden door.

a_gems_note.event: The founder's label: the ring is glass, the real things went somewhere safer; try the corridor.

a_gems_corridor.event: A blank corridor; the mark on a loose skirting board.

a_gems_alarm.event: The beeping is a tired sensor; the guard's torch comes; hide or freeze among the busts.

a_gems_hide.event: Behind the plinth Nadia hears the guard ask the diamond, after thirty-one years, for an answer.

b_egypt1.event: The Egyptian Wing: a crooked sarcophagus lid and an old wall map.

b_egypt_sarco.event: The lid was lifted and not set back; one amulet dent is empty.

b_egypt_lid.event: In the sarcophagus, the brass token; a draught from a gap in the wall.

b_egypt_amulet.event: The empty dent's card: the token of the house was removed by the founder, not far away.

b_egypt_hall.event: A bare hall; the mark on a rocking floor tile.

b_egypt_map.event: The old wall map shows her ringed wing beginning behind this room; a torch, and a roped gallery.

b_egypt_torch.event: By torch Nadia follows the lost wing as the wall map draws it, until the battery dies.

b_egypt_wedge.event: Warned by the map, Nadia wedges the door and finds arch 29, the way to the east wing.

c_archive1.event: The Archive: an open visitor ledger, and dark back stacks.

c_archive_ledger.event: The founder's ledger entry: "To hide something"; a card index and a stuck drawer.

c_archive_index.event: A card stamped with the mark: Row Q, behind the dictionaries.

c_archive_drawer.event: The stuck drawer gives the brass token and a plan ringing a shelf in Row Q.

c_archive_stack.event: In Row Q, the mark on a shelf edge and a gap behind the dictionaries.

c_archive_dark.event: The edge of the dark stacks: a lantern that would show through the grating, or counting by hand.

c_archive_lantern.event: The lantern draws no guard; she follows the letters to the last row.

c_archive_chalk.event: Chalk arrows lead her past the founder's tour records, 1 to 36 and four "For the finder," to Row Q.

n_key.event: The founder's brass key with a coded note and tag 37; stop thirty-seven: it fits his study, glass cabinet and back stair.

k_founder.event: The founder's study and his portrait, which hangs away from the wall.

k_founder_desk.event: In the desk, a notebook with a worked line of the code and the founder's reading glasses.

k_founder_portrait.event: Behind the portrait, a brass cipher wheel with two rings of letters.

k_display.event: The glass cabinet's lid is glued by age; the guard is coming up the stairs.

k_display_open.event: Patiently rocked, the lid opens as the guard turns away; a ribboned ledger.

k_cabinet.event: The ledger's marked page: the alphabet against the alphabet starting at D, a three-place table for the code.

k_display_force.event: The shoved lid sticks and the glass creaks; the guard calls out.

k_display_careful.event: Letting the lid down and trying gently, Nadia gets the ledger's three-place table and lights the reading lamp, whose bulb someone has kept changing.

k_stairs.event: The back stair, and a cupboard with something pale in it.

k_stairs_up.event: A brass dial at the stairhead: every letter steps three places on.

k_stairs_base.event: A chart of two letter rings and the founder's glasses: "Turn the inner ring three places."

k_study.event: The reading-table lamp still lights: someone changes the bulb; Nadia spreads the coded note.

n_cipher.event: Each letter stepped three places back, the note reads: follow the stars to the heart of the house by one of three roads, then set the rings to four, nine, two.

ci_stars.event: The Astronomy Hall: "one of those stars is a liar"; a spiral stair or a staff ladder.

ci_stars_dome.event: The liar star is a brass stud; it opens a passage to the middle of the museum.

ci_stars_ladder.event: A caged walkway to a door, or a bare ladder into the dark dome.

ci_stars_cross.event: On the walkway Nadia spots the liar star and presses it.

ci_map.event: The Map Room: a celestial floor globe and a giant atlas.

ci_map_globe.event: The gold star under the pointer opens a low panel.

ci_map_atlas.event: A hand-drawn chart of the museum as stars: "You are nearly there, so mind the crates."

ci_atlas2.event: Following the red route, she minds the crates, to a door with a gold star.

ci_clock.event: The Clock Corridor: a gear room, or under a great pendulum.

ci_clock_gears.event: Setting the master clock's hands on the gold star, as the note said to follow the stars, opens a door.

ci_clock_pendulum.event: The pendulum swings across the far doorway; learn its beat or dash.

ci_clock_cross.event: On the beat, Nadia walks through under the pendulum.

n_rotunda.event: Back in the rotunda the globe's pin drops and its rings come free; the NIGHT GUARD room stands empty.

ro_align.event: The rings turn too eagerly and the worn numbers look alike.

ro_align_set.event: Checked twice, the rings set to four, nine, two open a hidden stair.

ro_align_guess.event: By ear she sets them wrong and the third ring jams a finger short.

ro_align_retry.event: Freeing the ring and reading the numbers aloud, she opens the stair.

ro_panel.event: The pedestal's sliding tiles, and a draught from a hidden low door.

ro_panel_solve.event: The tiles make the mark from her map; a stair opens.

ro_panel_secret.event: Behind the low door, a dusty workshop; 39 chalked on the frame.

ro_workshop.event: Stop thirty-nine: Ellery's own hidden workshop of half-built clockwork, and a brass wren.

ro_records.event: The guard's warm chair, his rounds book, a crossword, a working phone.

ro_records_guard.event: The founder's rule: at a quarter to four, if the heart is awake, the clockwork sets the rings and opens the floor; it is sixteen to four, and she runs.

ro_records_note.event: Pym's note to "NADIA (NOT A BURGLAR)": he saw her board and waits at the front desk; his letters match the map.

ro_pym.event: At the front desk Pym's crossword clue is "Visitor"; he sees the key he hunted for thirty-one years.

ro_records_phone.event: A dial tone: home, or the three numbers she knows.

n_vault.event: Stop thirty-eight: the founder's hidden room of the town's treasures, a sealed letter, the other half of the map and a jewelled owl.

v_letter.event: The founder's letter: he hid the treasures from creditors and let the town call him a thief; key in forty.

v_letter_ps.event: Through the founder's glasses: whoever changes the reading-lamp bulb has earned a look; she knows who.

v_letter_reveal.event: Stop forty: Ellery thanks her and shows the book listing where every piece belongs.

v_reveal2.event: Reading the whole book, the town's thief becomes a man with a secret and nobody to tell.

v_letter_keep.event: Nadia keeps the letter for the right day and plan, and closes the slab behind her.

v_map.event: The two halves join: the lost east wing, bricked up but standing, through the back of the last shelf; the night is wearing thin.

v_map_follow.event: Through the last shelf into the lost wing of paintings the town thought sold.

v_map_photo.event: Nadia photographs the whole map and leaves the room untouched.

v_map_back.event: Joined, the back says the wing's one door opens onto the garden and her key fits it.

v_share.event: Nadia climbs up with the sealed letter; curator, Tess, or leave it for the museum.

v_share_curator.event: The curator arrives at eight to a sealed letter, then sees the open floor beside the globe.

v_share_secret.event: Nadia closes the slab, slips out with the morning's first keys, and tells Tess first.

v_share_museum.event: Nadia leaves both map halves, the combination, the sealed letter and the key on the guard's desk, and closes the slab.

v_grab.event: Lifting the owl starts a spring; the velvet shows a coin-sized hollow with the mark.

v_grab_run.event: She runs with the owl and the shelf's bells ring: it wanted something coin-shaped left.

v_grab_return.event: She sets the owl back and lists the room in pencil.

v_grab_swap.event: She leaves the token in the hollow; the owl speaks in Ellery's voice: believe whoever carries me.

e_set_alarm.event: Caught among the busts; guard Pym sees handset thirteen: he put the map there himself after thirty-one years.

e_set_locked_gallery.event: Shut in the roped gallery before the bricked arch 29, Nadia reads the map's back for the first time: "WEDGE IT."

e_set_stuck_dark.event: Lost in the dark stacks all night, Nadia wakes ten steps from the mark beside records 37 to 40, "For the finder."

e_set_broken_case.event: The glass cracks; the guard, thirty-one years a duster of that cabinet, finds the code table with her.

e_set_stuck_dome.event: Stuck high in the dome, Nadia sees the stars make the mark; the guard holds the ladder.

e_set_pendulum.event: Bumped down by the pendulum, Nadia loses the key down a grating; "Count to three and walk" is written underneath.

e_set_jammed_globe.event: The forced ring jams the globe; at a quarter to four the clockwork strains and the crack closes.

e_set_caught.event: The bells bring the guard; he takes the owl down and finds where it belongs.

e_set_dawn.event: Tracing every room until dawn, Nadia slips out and counts the wing's nine windows from the pavement.

e_win_secret_workshop.event: The brass wren sings and bows; Nadia waits for the curator with it.

e_win_night_guard.event: Nadia and Pym open the stair together and sit on its top step arguing over who tells the curator.

e_win_mystery_solved.event: The book and letter clear Ellery: "NOT A THIEF."

e_win_quiet_keeper.event: Over weeks Nadia leads the curator to the globe.

e_win_lost_wing.event: The lost wing is opened to the town.

e_win_founders_door.event: Out by the founder's garden door, in again as first in line.

e_win_owl_witness.event: The owl speaks to the curator, who cancels her nine o'clock.

e_win_hero_curator.event: The curator reads the letter aloud: Ellery did not sell the treasures.

e_win_secret_kept.event: Nadia and Tess keep the room for a term, with a rota.

e_win_donate.event: The museum finds it from her anonymous note; "Found by a curious visitor."

e_neutral_call_home.event: Nadia rings her mum and tells the guard everything while she waits.

e_neutral_evidence.event: Nadia brings the photographs to the curator, who reaches for her keys.

e_neutral_wiser.event: The curator believes her list: nobody could make up a shelf that counts.

payoff_sites.shows: she wedges the self-shutting gallery door and reaches arch 29
without it she is shut in the gallery
the joined back tells her the wing's door opens to the garden and her key fits
chalk arrows bring her through the dark stacks to Row Q
without chalk she is lost all night
Pym saw her board and left her a note
the token takes the owl's place and the owl speaks for her
without it the shelf's bells ring
the glasses read the postscript that points to the bulb-changer, Pym

e_set_alarm.gift: the guard is Pym, who planted the map, and he wants to know where she would have looked

e_set_locked_gallery.gift: arch 29 shows the east wing still stands, and the map's back had warned her: a laugh at herself

e_set_stuck_dark.gift: records 37 to 40 "For the finder" ten steps away, and the lesson of the chalk

e_set_broken_case.gift: the guard finds the code table with her and keeps her place with the ribbon

e_set_stuck_dome.gift: from the top of the dome the stars draw the mark, and the guard holds the ladder

e_set_pendulum.gift: "Count to three and walk" written under the pendulum

e_set_jammed_globe.gift: at a quarter to four the globe tries to open by itself: the stair is real

e_set_caught.gift: the guard laughs below and the bells stop: he found where the owl belongs

e_set_dawn.gift: she counts the wing's nine windows from the pavement she walks every week
